$comment: Column contract for a cpt_rec knowledge-base CSV. See data/kb/README.md.

code_system.description: Which code set the row belongs to.

code.description: Uppercase, modifier-free base code, e.g. 45378 or A0021.

code_description.description: Official short/long descriptor for the code.

code_lay_term.description: Optional long-form plain-language description. Improves dense retrieval; the pipeline runs without it. Commonly licensed -- supply your own or leave empty.

code_range_{i}.description: Hierarchy node at level i, e.g. 45300-45399.

notes: Levels need not all be populated; code_range_deepest resolves the most specific non-empty node.
Rows are looked up by `code`, so duplicates are an error.
Descriptor text for CPT (Level I) is copyrighted by the AMA and is NOT distributed with this repository.
